stages.title: Project setup and first deploy
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-0-setup.md: four tasks, a review per task, a final whole-branch review on Opus and one fix wave. Decisions by Arthur during the stage: events.user_id nullable (a Lead or Purchase whose click lost its user), events.event_id NOT NULL (SQLite allows NULL in a TEXT primary key), 14-day retention on both queues per ADR 0005, deploy secrets in the GitHub Environment argus-cloudflare restricted to main, an account API token with four Edit scopes and 90 days expiry, .worktreeinclude for local-only files. Setup traps found on the way: the test package is now @cloudflare/vitest-plugin, compatibility_date is capped by the test runtime (2026-11-03), wrangler types needs --strict-vars=false. The two D1 databases already existed on the account (created 2026-11-04 18:14Z) and were reused. Explain-back: Arthur described the two D1 databases and the R2 path himself and asked about logs, Queues, Analytics Engine and bindings, which were explained.
stages.verified: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm test (6 passed, 2 files); CI check job green on PR #1; remote sqlite_master: facts has the 8 tables of data-model.md, events has events (event_id NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY; client_time, seq, user_id nullable); both queues at 1209600 s retention (dashboard); environment argus-cloudflare holds both secrets and allows only main. GET /healthz on the deployed Worker is checked against the merge commit right after this commit deploys.

stages.title: Identity, selection and the quiz
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-1-quiz.md, with a review per task, a final whole-branch review and one fix wave. A second review of the PR by five small reviewers, one per area, found six defects, all fixed in the PR: a later completion now removes older answers it no longer carries; parseFlow rejects branch values a step does not offer and steps unreachable from first; decrypt accepts only v1:iv:ct with a 12-byte IV; the email form posts; parseCatalog reports a repeated offer id; the TEST_ROUTES gate is tested on ON, empty and missing. Decisions by Arthur: test routes are on for the deployed demo (TEST_ROUTES is off in wrangler.jsonc and CI deploys with --var TEST_ROUTES:on), and everything user-facing is in English, so the no-offer text is "No offer available". Tooling added in the stage: a Claude Code PostToolUse hook runs oxfmt and oxlint on every edited file, and oxlint now runs the suspicious category and the vitest plugin and fails on warnings. Traps: `pnpm test -t "X"` filters, while `pnpm test -- -t "X"` runs everything; the global Env needs augmenting for typecheck without .dev.vars; secret values cannot be read back from Cloudflare, so .dev.vars.remote is the only copy. Deferred: no body size cap on /api/complete; re-seeding keeps an old partner secret (rotation per ADR 0007 is not built yet); two completions in the same millisecond keep the first; moving the identity middleware.
stages.verified: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm test (138 passed, 13 files); CI check job green on PR #2. GET /healthz, the remote seed, DEMO-2 and partner_secrets_ok are checked against the merge commit right after this commit deploys.

stages.title: Events
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-2-events.md: five tasks, a review per task, a final whole-branch review and one fix wave, then one change by Arthur after the review. Decisions by Arthur: (1) an email inside an event payload: the producer's sanitizePayload() removes every payload key whose name contains email, at any depth, and leaves string values alone; an email inside a string of an unknown type is the accepted risk R-23; (2) the browser outbox drops an unsent event older than one day by its client_time. Rulings during the build: the test plugin reports per-message retries as retryMessages, so the tests follow it instead of the plan's explicitRetries. Defects the reviews found and fixed: a malformed visit_id from the completion body produced Queue messages that could never be stored (now replaced by a Worker UUID); a payload nested about 1000 levels passed the edge, failed json_valid in D1 and sent the whole batch to the dead letter queue (now capped at 32 levels at the edge and in the stored schema); a HEAD request counted as an entry; the outbox waited for the next event to retry (now a 30-second timer); a prelander id outside the id pattern was accepted from the config. Explain-back: Arthur followed one step_answered from the outbox through the Worker checks, the Queue and the consumer into D1, and asked what producer.ts is for; the duplicate and the Queue-down cases were walked through with him. Deferred: a body cap enforced while the body streams, before c.req.text(); a row-by-row fallback when a batch insert fails (the consumer is replaced in stage 5); server events are lost with a log line when the Queue refuses, until the R2 fallback of stage 5.
stages.verified: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm test (217 passed, 20 files); pnpm test -t "TEST-3|ID-1|ID-2|ID-4|BIZ-2|QZ-4|QZ-5|NFR-4|NFR-5|NFR-8|R-12|R-14|R-23" (100 passed); against wrangler dev one visit through completion stored 8 events and no test email in logs or state; Arthur ran the browser flow locally. The same body twice and the 8 events of a browser visit are checked against BASE right after this commit deploys.

stages.title: Redirect, postbacks and the Lead return
stages.verified: pnpm check (333 passed, 30 files); pnpm test -t "OFF-3|OFF-4|OFF-9|ID-3" (36 passed); pnpm test -t "PB-5|TEST-3" (10 passed); pnpm test -t "PB-3|PB-8" (27 passed); pnpm test -t "A-4|NFR-1|DEMO-3|DEMO-4|DEMO-6" (6 passed); grep -rnE -- "curl .*-L( |$)|redirect: ?follow" tests/ scripts/ docs/testing/ prints nothing. DEMO-3, DEMO-4, the repeated Lead and GET /healthz are checked against BASE right after this commit deploys.
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-3-redirect-postbacks.md: five tasks, a review per task, a final whole-branch review and one fix wave. Decisions by Arthur: (1) GET /go?prelander=&visit= carries no offer id; the Worker runs select() for the cookie's user at the press, writes the click, then answers 302, so nothing in the URL can be swapped and a catalog change between showing and pressing applies (R-9); offer_selected with moment redirect is dropped and a visit stays at 9 events; (2) a user with no users row at /go gets a 302 to /p/{prelander} (Q-30); (3) only Arthur can send postbacks to the deployed Worker, because the test partner secrets are in his .dev.vars.remote; reviewers run the demo locally with their own .dev.vars. Correction during the stage: data-model.md said a duplicate postback sends no event; it now follows ADR 0007, so a duplicate sends the event again with the same derived EventID and an event lost to a Queue failure after the D1 write still arrives once. Rulings during the build: every test that changes an offer restores it in finally; every current-design mention of /go/{offer} was updated, earlier stage plans and docs/ai were left as written; the postback event carries payout as the partner's decimal string and occurred_at in ms, while conversions.payout stays REAL; 500 config_error when a partner secret cannot be decrypted. Defects the reviews found and fixed: design.md said 503 happens only when D1 is down (the Queue too, after the row is written); part2-mvp-stages.md said only an accepted postback sends the event; X-Signature had no cap on v1 values (now 8); pnpm postback printed a stack trace when the Worker was unreachable. Explain-back: Arthur first described the Lead return (new visit and click ids) when asked about a redelivered Lead; after the question was restated he named transaction_id as what tells a redelivery from a second Purchase, and said /go selects the offer again at the press. Deferred: a known-answer HMAC vector computed outside the code (before stage 7); the README must say reviewers run postbacks locally (stage 7); catalog_config_error logging at /go and entry (stage 6); stage 4 decides how clicks with user_id null count, and conversions join through clicks; remote atomicity of wrangler d1 execute --file is probed before the first pnpm offer --remote.
